description: This PHP source file manages the remote management configuration interface for a network device. It includes PHP code for retrieving current settings, JavaScript for dynamic UI interactions and validation, and HTML for the form layout. The file handles enabling/disabling remote management via HTTP/HTTPS, setting allowed IP addresses or ranges, and includes external PHP includes for headers, navigation, and utility functions.

methods.name: KeyExtGet
methods.description: Retrieves configuration values based on key prefixes and parameters.

methods.name: getStr
methods.description: Fetches specific string values from device configuration or status.

methods.name: get_wan_type
methods.description: Returns the type of WAN connection (e.g., EPON).

methods.name: getInstanceIds
methods.description: Returns instance IDs for IPv6 address blocks.
